about: projects-tab PERF-12 (projects-joint J18): first-load JavaScript per route, in bytes, from the built manifests (rootMainFiles + the client-reference manifest entryJSFiles; scripts/perf/route-js-budget/budget.mjs). A route not named in `routes` is held to defaultRouteMaxBytes under the (protected) layout and to publicDefaultRouteMaxBytes outside it; every route's shell to shellMaxBytes. Set 2026-11-18 from the measured build of the J18 change, each rounded up from the measurement plus 3% headroom. A route over its budget fails `npm run perf:budget` (run after `next build`, and in CI). Raising a budget is a decision: say why in the commit.
